first: Stop. Don't take another step… Are you real? Here, sometimes, things aren't.

first.speaker: Nico
first.text: I'm Nico. I was shipwrecked on this island and I'm looking for the pieces of my compass to get home.

first: Home…? I know I've been here before… but I don't remember how I got here.
Look at the walls: names, tally marks, drawings of ships. Other travelers crossed these ruins before us.
None of them wrote down how they got out.
again: The ruins are not empty. Something crawls through the stone passages, and it has been here longer than any of us.
The Stone Serpent guards the blue fragment. It slides between the levels: when you lose sight of it, don't stand still.
And don't trust the silence. The stones of this place… listen.

final.speaker: Nico
final.text: The Serpent has fallen. The blue fragment is already shining in my compass.

final: So it's true. What this island puts in front of you can be beaten.
While you were fighting, I remembered something: a temple, an eclipse… and a man who talked about prices.
Go to the temple, Nico. If you find the way home, maybe I'll remember it too.
